verdict.rationale: Docs confirm that conversation transcripts and audio recordings are stored with configurable retention, and that conversations can be searched, analyzed, and have structured data extracted (docs-26/52, docs-21/23/56), implying underlying storage of call recordings/transcripts. However, there is no explicit documentation of a specific API endpoint or method for programmatically retrieving full call recordings and transcripts on a per-call basis. Missing for 10: an explicit 'get conversation' or 'get recording/transcript' API reference, example request/response showing programmatic export of audio + transcript per call.
